$comment: The only colour source for on-screen UI (plan 20, docs/accessibility.md). tamagui.config.ts merges `themes.<scheme>.text`, `.graphic` and `onFill` into every light / dark theme as `$accent`, `$statusError`, … ; components read them as tokens or through usePalette(). `npm run check:contrast` (scripts/contrast-check.mjs) fails CI when a text token is under 4.5:1 or a graphic token under 3:1 against any of its theme's surfaces, or when onFill text is under 4.5:1 on a text token used as a fill. `chrome` is the navigation bar / header (React Navigation sits outside the Tamagui theme), its text checked against its background. `brand` is the fixed logo / splash artwork, the same in both themes.
